skygo info
stdout 'NAME +KIND +CAPABILITIES'
stdout 'supported +local +finite-jobs-v1'
stdout 'unknown +fixture +unknown\(99\)'
! stderr .
skygo --json info --target supported --require finite-jobs-v1
stdout '"name": *"supported"'
stdout '"capabilities": *\["CAPABILITY_FINITE_JOBS_V1"\]'
! stdout 'limited'
! stdout 'task_semantics_version'
! stderr .
! skygo info --target limited --require finite-jobs-v1
stderr 'failed_precondition: target "limited" does not advertise finite-jobs-v1'
! stdout .
! skygo info --target unknown --require finite-jobs-v1
stderr 'failed_precondition'
! stdout .
! skygo info --require finite-jobs-v1
stderr 'requirements need --target'
! stdout .
! skygo info --target absent
stderr 'not_found'
! stdout .
! skygo info --target supported --require future-jobs
stderr 'unknown capability "future-jobs"'
! stdout .
env SKYGO_TOKEN=
! skygo --token wrong info
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! stderr 'legacy'
! stdout .
env SKYGO_TOKEN=info-token
skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 info --help
stdout '--target'
stdout '--require'
! stderr .

# The new feature is an endpoint fact; old advertisements cannot satisfy it.
! skygo info --require artifact-begin-requests-v1
stderr 'endpoint does not advertise artifact-begin-requests-v1'
! stdout .
